reasonSummary: 560 of 564 Users canonical hashes were reproduced exactly (2026-07-30 bounded read-only WP capture reconciled against approved LOCAL MigrationRecord.normalizedPayload ground truth, one uniform rule). These 4 did not reproduce; no deterministic common reconstruction rule exists, and no per-user invented value is permitted. (A 5th record, wordpress-db:user:43, was originally excluded for the same reason but was reincluded 2026-07-31 by explicit founder decision because the available display name satisfies the User schema without inventing profile data; see WP_USER_43_REINCLUDED_FOR_CONTENT_OWNERSHIP.)
scopeEffect: Temporary release exclusion, not a deletion and not a determination that these records are invalid. Reduces the first-release executable Users scope from 564 to 560. Excluded records remain migration-eligible and must be revisited in a documented post-release backlog.
postReleaseBacklogRequirement: Must be tracked as an open post-release backlog item until either a deterministic reconstruction rule is found or the original historical snapshot is discovered.
